text: 记者从工业和信息化部了解到，2026年前7个月，我国软件和信息技术服务业运行态势良好，软件业务收入稳健增长，利润总额增势平稳，软件业务出口保持正增长。今年前7个月，我国软件业务收入89785亿元，同比增长9.2%；软件业利润总额超过万亿元，同比增长1.3%。软件业务出口406.1亿美元，同比增长12.2%。分领域运行情况显示，软件产品收入稳定增长。前7个月，软件产品收入占全行业收入比重为21.6%。信息技术服务收入继续保持两位数增长。今年1—7月，信息技术服务收入同比增长10%，占全行业收入的68.7%。（央视新闻）
text_en: The reporter learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that in the first seven months of 2026, China's software and information technology services industry performed well, with steady growth in software business revenue, stable profit growth, and positive growth in software business exports. In the first seven months of this year, China's software business revenue reached 8.9785 trillion yuan, up 9.2% year-on-year; total software industry profits exceeded 1 trillion yuan, up 1.3% year-on-year. Software business exports reached $40.61 billion, up 12.2% year-on-year. By segment, software product revenue grew steadily, accounting for 21.6% of total industry revenue in the first seven months. Information technology services revenue continued double-digit growth, up 10% year-on-year from January to July, accounting for 68.7% of industry revenue. (CCTV News)
